Find official information about Canadian immigration pathways, permits, visas and settlement support.

Important: This is an independent information directory, not immigration or legal advice. We are not Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC), and we do not process applications or guarantee approvals. Rules and eligibility change; always check official sources. Only authorized representatives may provide paid immigration advice or representation under Canadian rules.
